verses.en: And in that day thou shalt say, O LORD, I will praise thee: though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away, and thou comfortedst me.
verses.sm: Atua Aw e, ou te vivii atu ia te oe, aua sa e toatamai la te au, a ua mavae lou toasa, ma ua e faamatalaloto mai ia te au.

verses.en: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
verses.sm: Faauta, o le Atua, o loʻu faaolataga la; ou te faatuatua, ou te le fefe; aua o le ALII le ATUA, o loʻu malosi ia ma laʻu pese; ua avea foi o ia moʻu faaolataga.

verses.en: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.
verses.sm: Tou te utu vai ma le olioli i vaipuna o le faaolataga.

verses.en: And in that day shall ye say, Praise the LORD, call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.
verses.sm: O lea aso foi tou te faapea atu ai, la outou vivii atu i le ALII, ina valaau atu ia i lona suafa; ia outou faailoa atu i nuu o ana galuega; ia outou tautau atu ua yna lona suafa.

verses.en: Sing unto the LORD; for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.
verses.sm: Pepese atu ia i le ALII, aua ua faia e ia mea silisili ese; ina faailoa atu ia o lea mea i le lalolagi uma.

verses.en: Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.
verses.sm: Alaga ia, ia leo tele ma le fiafia, o oe o lé nofo i Siona; aua e silisili ese le Paia o
